purpose: Coverage-first measurement of the first non-pass task in the fixed 189-task development ledger under the unchanged current generic candidate.
change_scope: No task-driven code change. Measure the unchanged generic candidate on the first non-pass ledger task using a fresh VM and immutable result directory.

implementation_evidence.candidate_status: The unchanged v44 candidate clean-passed orders 82 and 83 with original evaluator 1.0, generic_api_only, and strict audit valid=true after model-selected arguments reached the Adapter unchanged.
implementation_evidence.current_order_preflight: The unchanged generic instruction router includes settings.set_default_font in the initial Top-K and excludes task.execute. This existing action still has a legacy params wrapper, so the immutable run measures whether Qwen can form the nested public contract without an order-84-driven source or prompt change.
implementation_evidence.hypothesis: The v43 model repeatedly selected the correct existing action but its opaque legacy wrapper elicited an invalid params string on every attempt. A direct positive numeric point-size contract should let Qwen provide its own requested value without Runner defaults, argument injection, task identity, or an answer route.
implementation_evidence.preserved_v43_failure: experiments/generic-only-coverage-order82-v43-run1 is immutable: evaluator 0.0, 30 steps, no Agent termination, 13 catalog searches, 14 correct action selections with invalid opaque params strings, no Adapter mutation, generic_api_only, and strict audit valid=true.
implementation_evidence.current_router_check: Varied requests for italicized, oblique, and italic text at 16, 17, and 18 points all expose text.resize_italic_runs in the initial Top-K. A regular all-paragraph 16-point request exposes paragraph.set_format and does not expose the italic-run action. task.execute is absent.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual: Tests use unrelated manuscripts, reports, and notes with 8.5, 16, 17, and 18 point values; reject missing, zero, string, opaque params, and unexpected arguments; preserve subscript routing; and verify exact Runtime forwarding of a model-selected 17 without task identity, filename, or fixed task answer.
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes
implementation_evidence.changed_source_leakage_scan: No current task UUID, source episode ID, source filename, instruction fingerprint, golden value, evaluator expected state, or fixed font size was added to production code or counterfactual tests.

selection.method: first non-pass in the task-ID-deduplicated development coverage ledger
